claims.text: There is a Southeast Asia propylene spot price series assessed from January 2024 to December 2025, covering 24 months.
There is a Southeast Asia propylene contract price series assessed from January 2026 to August 2026, covering 8 months.
No price assessments for Southeast Asia propylene spot or contract are available for months outside the periods January 2024–December 2025 (spot) and January 2026–August 2026 (contract).
There are no months with blank prices or missing rows in the Southeast Asia propylene spot price series from January 2024 to December 2025.
There are no months with blank prices or missing rows in the Southeast Asia propylene contract price series from January 2026 to August 2026.
Spot and contract price series for Southeast Asia propylene are not directly comparable, as they are assessed on different bases.

citations.quote: A product assessed on two bases appears as two series. Values on different bases are not directly comparable.
